definition: to succeed in doing something after trying hard
example: She worked hard to achieve her goal of passing the exam.
example_ru: Она усердно работала, чтобы достичь своей цели — сдать экзамен.

definition: to take something from someone and return it later
example: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
example_ru: Можно я одолжу твою ручку на минутку?

definition: to do something enjoyable because of a special occasion
example: We are going to celebrate my birthday at a pizza place.
example_ru: Мы собираемся отпраздновать мой день рождения в пиццерии.

definition: something new and difficult that tests your ability
example: Learning a new language is a great challenge.
example_ru: Изучение нового языка — это большой вызов.

definition: to share information with others by speaking or writing
example: It is important to communicate with your classmates.
example_ru: Важно общаться с одноклассниками.

definition: the natural world and the conditions around us
example: We must protect the environment from pollution.
example_ru: Мы должны защищать окружающую среду от загрязнения.

definition: knowledge or skill that you get from doing something
example: Summer camp was an unforgettable experience for me.
example_ru: Летний лагерь был для меня незабываемым опытом.

definition: to make something better or to become better
example: I want to improve my English speaking skills.
example_ru: Я хочу улучшить свои навыки разговорного английского.

definition: to affect how someone or something develops
example: Social media can influence how teenagers think.
example_ru: Социальные сети могут влиять на то, как думают подростки.

definition: to succeed in doing something difficult, or to be in charge
example: It is hard to manage my time between school and sports.
example_ru: Трудно распределять время между школой и спортом.

definition: a chance to do something
example: Studying abroad is a great opportunity to learn a language.
example_ru: Учеба за границей — отличная возможность выучить язык.

definition: to like one thing or person more than another
example: I prefer reading books to watching movies.
example_ru: Я предпочитаю читать книги, а не смотреть фильмы.

definition: to get ready for something
example: We need to prepare for the school trip tomorrow.
example_ru: Нам нужно подготовиться к завтрашней школьной поездке.

definition: to suddenly understand or become aware of something
example: I didn't realize the test was today.
example_ru: Я не осознавал, что тест сегодня.

definition: to suggest that something is good or suitable
example: Can you recommend a good book for the weekend?
example_ru: Можешь порекомендовать хорошую книгу на выходные?

definition: to make something smaller in size or amount
example: We need to reduce the amount of plastic we use.
example_ru: Нам нужно сократить количество используемого пластика.

definition: the way two people or groups feel and act towards each other
example: She has a good relationship with her parents.
example_ru: У нее хорошие отношения с родителями.

definition: having a duty to deal with something or someone
example: You are responsible for cleaning your room.
example_ru: Ты ответственный за уборку своей комнаты.

definition: a plan that gives times for things to happen
example: My school schedule is very busy this week.
example_ru: Мое школьное расписание очень загружено на этой неделе.

definition: an answer to a problem or a difficult situation
example: We found a quick solution to the math problem.
example_ru: Мы нашли быстрое решение математической задачи.

definition: to mention an idea or plan for someone to think about
example: I suggest we go to the park after school.
example_ru: Я предлагаю пойти в парк после школы.

definition: to help and encourage someone
example: My friends always support me when I have problems.
example_ru: Мои друзья всегда поддерживают меня, когда у меня проблемы.

definition: to continue to live or exist, especially after a difficult time
example: It is amazing how animals survive in the cold.
example_ru: Удивительно, как животные выживают на холоде.

definition: happening in the usual way, or having the usual qualities
example: It is typical for him to be late for class.
example_ru: Для него типично опаздывать на урок.

definition: different from what is normal or expected
example: It is unusual to see snow in this city in May.
example_ru: В этом городе необычно видеть снег в мае.

definition: worth a lot of money, or very useful and important
example: The teacher gave me some valuable advice.
example_ru: Учитель дал мне несколько ценных советов.

definition: many different types of things or people
example: The school offers various clubs and sports activities.
example_ru: Школа предлагает различные клубы и спортивные мероприятия.

definition: to offer to do something without being paid
example: I want to volunteer at the local animal shelter.
example_ru: Я хочу поработать волонтером в местном приюте для животных.

definition: the condition of the air outside (rain, sun, wind, etc.)
example: The weather is perfect for a picnic today.
example_ru: Погода сегодня идеальна для пикника.
